description: This file contains an abstract test case class for unit testing API endpoints in the OrangeHRM project. It sets up request mocks, exception expectations, and validation helpers for testing endpoint behavior.

classes.name: EndpointTestCase
classes.description: An abstract PHPUnit test case class providing utilities for testing API endpoints in OrangeHRM, including request setup, exception expectation, and validation helpers.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a Request object with specified query, request, and attribute parameters.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMockBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mock builder for a specified API class, configured with a request created using passed request parameters.

methods.name: expectNotImplementedException
methods.description: Sets expectation that a NotImplementedException will be thrown.

methods.name: expectRecordNotFoundException
methods.description: Sets expectation that a RecordNotFoundException will be thrown.

methods.name: expectBadRequestException
methods.description: Sets expectation that a BadRequestException will be thrown.

methods.name: expectInvalidParamException
methods.description: Sets expectation that an InvalidParamException will be thrown.

methods.name: expectForbiddenException
methods.description: Sets expectation that a ForbiddenException will be thrown.

methods.name: assertInvalidParamException
methods.description: Asserts that a given validation closure throws an InvalidParamException with expected invalid keys.
